translationRepairs: He served in succession as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, counsellor of the Office of Transmission, reader in the Grand Secretariat, minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and minister of the Court of Imperial Music.

He served in succession as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, counsellor of the Office of Transmission, reader in the Grand Secretariat, minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
s0018 lists 光祿寺少卿、光祿寺卿、then 太常寺卿. 光祿寺 is the Court of Imperial Entertainments, not Sacrifices; 太常寺 is Sacrifices, not Music. The proposed office sequence matches the Chinese.

He served successively as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, counsellor of the Office of Transmission, reader in the Grand Secretariat, minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and minister of the Court of Imperial Music.

He served successively as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, counsellor of the Office of Transmission, reader in the Grand Secretariat, minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
The same unit has 光祿寺 for the first and fourth posts and 太常寺 for the last. Rendering 太常寺 as Imperial Music and 光祿寺 as Sacrifices invents the wrong offices; Entertainments then Sacrifices is correct.
Soon after, because he failed to reach the fasting lodge during the abstention period, he was demoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Music.
Soon after, because he failed to reach the fasting lodge during the abstention period, he was demoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
s0057 has 降授太常寺少卿. 太常寺 is the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Imperial Music is a false office name.
Soon afterward, because during the fasting period he had not reached the fasting lodge, he was demoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Music.
Soon afterward, because during the fasting period he had not reached the fasting lodge, he was demoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
The demotion target is 太常寺少卿, which must be vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, not Imperial Music.

In 1821 he was ordered with Vice Minister Ming Antai of the Court of Imperial Music to Yangcun to inspect stripped transport boats, then proceeded to Dongguang and Lulong to hear capital appeals, sentencing each case according to law;

In 1821 he was ordered with Vice Minister Ming Antai of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to Yangcun to inspect lighter boats for cargo transfer, then proceeded to Dongguang and Lulong to hear capital appeals, sentencing each case according to law;
s0059 has 太常寺少卿明安泰 and 挑驗剝船. 太常寺 is Sacrifices, not Music; Qing 剝船 are lighter boats for cargo transfer, not stripped boats.

In the first year of Daoguang he was ordered to go with Vice Minister Ming Antai of the Court of Imperial Music to Yangcun to inspect stripped transport boats, and then proceeded to Dongguang and Lulong to examine and try capital-appeal cases, each sentenced according to law;

In the first year of Daoguang he was ordered to go with Vice Minister Ming Antai of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to Yangcun to inspect lighter boats for cargo transfer, and then proceeded to Dongguang and Lulong to examine and try capital-appeal cases, each sentenced according to law;
The same Chinese names Ming Antai’s office as 太常寺少卿 and the boats as 剝船; Sacrifices plus lighter boats for cargo transfer restores both meanings.
In 1823 he became minister of the Court of Imperial Music, was appointed educational commissioner of Anhui, and was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
In 1823 he became minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was appointed educational commissioner of Anhui, and was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
s0061 has 轉太常寺卿. 太常寺卿 is minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, not Imperial Music.
In the third year he was transferred to minister of the Court of Imperial Music, appointed educational commissioner of Anhui, and promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
In the third year he was transferred to minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, appointed educational commissioner of Anhui, and promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
The transfer is to 太常寺卿; Court of Imperial Sacrifices matches the Chinese, Imperial Music does not.

He memorialized on the abuse of prefects and magistrates maintaining private tutoring halls, requesting strict prohibition, and also forbade supervising students from serving as arresters, tax collectors, and similar roles.

He memorialized on the abuse of prefects and magistrates maintaining private detention houses, requesting strict prohibition, and also forbade Imperial Academy students from serving as arresters, tax collectors, and similar roles.
班館 are illicit private detention houses, so tutoring halls is wrong; but 監生 are Imperial Academy students (jiansheng), not supervising students, so the proposed after still needs that correction.

He memorialized stating the abuse of prefects and magistrates privately establishing class halls, requesting strict prohibition, and also prohibiting supervising students from serving as arresters, tax collectors, and the like.

He memorialized stating the abuse of prefects and magistrates privately establishing detention houses, requesting strict prohibition, and also prohibiting Imperial Academy students from serving as arresters, tax collectors, and the like.
班館 correctly become detention houses, yet 監生 remains mistranslated as supervising students; Imperial Academy students matches the Chinese.

He served in succession as vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, minister of the Court of Imperial Music, director of the Imperial Clan Court, and left vice censor-in-chief of the Censorate.

He served in succession as vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, director of the Imperial Clan Court, and left vice censor-in-chief of the Censorate.
s0120 lists 太常寺卿 among the successive posts. That office is minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, not Imperial Music.

He served successively as vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, minister of the Court of Imperial Music, director of the Imperial Clan Court, and left vice censor-in-chief of the Censorate.

He served successively as vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, director of the Imperial Clan Court, and left vice censor-in-chief of the Censorate.
The Chinese office is 太常寺卿; Sacrifices is the accurate English, Music is not.
